macros.name: addtonotes
macros.doc: The macro \addtonotes{⟨text⟩} inserts ⟨text⟩ into the ent file.

macros.name: chaptername
macros.doc: The command \chaptername is supplied by the LaTeX classes that provide \chapter divisions and is defined to produce ‘Chapter’.

macros.name: makepagenote
macros.doc: If you want to have page/end notes, the \makepagenote command must be put in the preamble. Among other things, this sets up the note ent file.

macros.name: noteidinnotes
macros.doc: The macro \noteidinnotes{⟨notenum⟩}{⟨id⟩} is designed to typeset the note number and/or the note id (from the optional hid i argument to \pagenote).

macros.name: noteinnotes
macros.doc: \noteinnotes{⟨text⟩} is used to typeset the note’s text (in the note list).

macros.name: notenumintext
macros.doc: The macro \notenumintext{⟨num⟩} is called by \pagenote to print the pagenote number.

macros.name: pageinnotes
macros.doc: The macro \pageinnotes{⟨pagenum⟩} is used for typesetting (or ignoring) the page number where the note was specified, and \noteinnotes{⟨text⟩} sets the actual note ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: pagename
macros.doc: The macros \sectionname and \pagename are provided by this package, producing respectively ‘Section’ and ‘page’.

macros.name: pagenote
macros.doc: \pagenote[⟨id⟩]{⟨text⟩} is used where you want a note to be inserted, although it will not be printed there.

macros.name: pagenote
macros.doc: \pagenote[⟨id⟩]{⟨text⟩} is used where you want a note to be inserted, although it will not be printed there.

macros.name: pagenotesubhead
macros.doc: This macro is used to typeset a heading for each set of notes.

macros.name: postnoteinnotes
macros.doc: The macros \prenoteinnotes and \postnoteinnotes are used to start and end the typesetting of the note — effectively typesetting each note as a paragraph; their definitions can be changed if need be.

macros.name: printnotes
macros.doc: The \printnotes command will cause the ent file to be closed for any new notes, and then \input in order to print the collected notes.

macros.name: printnotes*
macros.doc: The \printnotes command will cause the ent file to be closed for any new notes, and then \input in order to print the collected notes.

macros.name: sectionname
macros.doc: The macros \sectionname and \pagename are provided by this package, producing respectively ‘Section’ and ‘page’.
